title: 3.3.9 Sum an Array
description: Use a for loop to add up all numbers in an array, then log the total. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Create a number array
steps.instructions: Create a variable called numbers and assign it an array containing at least four number values.

steps.title: Sum with a for loop
steps.instructions: Create a variable called total and set it to 0. Write a for loop that visits every element in numbers: either by index (from 0 up to numbers.length - 1) or with for...of. On each iteration, add the current element to total.

steps.title: Log the result
steps.instructions: After the loop, use console.log to print the value of total.

requirements.title: for loop present
requirements.description: Code contains a for loop. Help: 3.3.5 (Looping Over Arrays (for / for…of))

requirements.title: the loop adds to total
requirements.description: A for loop body adds each element to a running total (total += ..., or total = total + ...). Adding the same number every time, like total += 1, counts items instead of summing them. Help: 3.3.5 (Looping Over Arrays (for / for…of))

requirements.title: console.log present
requirements.description: Code calls console.log. Help: 3.3.5 (Looping Over Arrays (for / for…of))
